import Mathlib.Probability.Moments.Variance
import Mathlib.Probability.Distributions.Uniform
import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Tactic
#check_failure Roth.card_filter_weight_le
#check @ProbabilityTheory.meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq
#check @ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun.variance_sum
#check @ProbabilityTheory.variance_sum_pi
#check @ProbabilityTheory.variance_le_sq_of_bounded
#check @PMF.toMeasure_uniformOfFintype_apply
namespace Audit132Probability
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
theorem chebyshevApplication {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    {X : Ω → ℝ} (hX : MemLp X 2 μ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    μ {ω | c ≤ |X ω - ∫ x, X x ∂μ|} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (variance X μ / c ^ 2) :=
  meas_ge_le_variance_div_sq hX hc
#print axioms chebyshevApplication
end Audit132Probability
